services.title: Facade repair
services.short: Cladding, mosaic tiles, joints, painting and bond testing.
services.body: Removal and reinstallation of cladding, crack and movement-joint treatment, painting and waterproofing. Pull-off tests on the scratch and render coats confirm adhesion before handover.
services.caption: Nahum Prado building before the cladding replacement

services.title: Structural repair
services.short: Rebar treatment, structural mortar and strengthening.
services.body: Removal of deteriorated concrete, cleaning and protection of reinforcement, reinstatement with structural mortar and strengthening of beams and slabs, under an engineer of record.
services.caption: Exposed rebar at the Solar do Atlântico building

services.title: Steel structures
services.short: Extensions, roofs and mezzanines, designed and erected.
services.body: Supply and erection of steel-section structures with steel-frame and drywall enclosures. The Hospital São Luiz extension alone took 18 tonnes of structural steel.
services.caption: Steel erection at Hospital São Luiz

services.title: Renovations and extensions
services.short: Hospitals, offices, retail and common areas.
services.body: Renovation of hospital wards, imaging departments, bathrooms and kitchens, as well as shops, offices and condominium common areas.
services.caption: Hospital São Luiz, Vila Velha

services.title: Technical reports and surveys
services.short: Building inspections, technical opinions and certified reports.
services.body: Technical opinions for condominiums and inspection reports, issued with a technical responsibility record (ART) by a civil engineer, to support decisions before work is commissioned.
services.caption: Facade inspection from a suspended platform

services.title: Property development
services.short: In-house residential developments, from land to title deeds.
services.body: In-house residential developments: design, permits, construction, occupancy permit and individual title deeds. The Luamar condominium in Jacaraípe was the first.
services.caption: Luamar condominium, Jacaraípe

sobre.title: An engineering company from Serra, with every job signed off and documented.
sobre.lead: PCR Engenharia e Incorporação was incorporated on 27 April 2018 in Serra, Espírito Santo, to serve condominiums and companies that needed proper engineering for repair and renovation work.
historia: The first contracts, in 2018, were the construction of the Cafeteria e Choperia do Mestre in the arrivals hall of Vitória Airport and works at the Laguna building in Jardim Camburi.

From 2019 the company took on facade repairs for residential buildings in Vitória and, in 2021, began working for the Kora Saúde hospital group on renovations and extensions, including the steel-frame extension of Hospital São Luiz in Vila Velha.
In 2023 PCR completed its first in-house development, the Luamar condominium: three semi-detached houses in Jacaraípe.
sobre.atuacao: Projects and reports in Serra, Vitória, Vila Velha, Cariacica, Anchieta and Aracruz, in the state of Espírito Santo.
sobre.grupoText: PCR belongs to the same business group as Deck Construtora e Incorporadora.
